body: ADDITIONAL CROSS-RECORD INVARIANT found while mapping the DTO: AlignWire.costBreakdown cannot validate against its eventual map key. Today a costs(unit)(Source(ref)) record can claim mode=Distorted, a Distorted key can carry the wrong facet set, or an External key can carry a source mode; gate validation checks only the key, while consumers can read breakdown.isDistorted/facets and receive a contradictory record. Add to HsmmResult.validated cost scan: admitted Source => breakdown.mode == Some(Faithful) and exclusion empty; admitted Distorted(ref, fs) => mode == Some(Distorted(fs)) and exclusion empty; External => mode/exclusion empty. Reject as MalformedRecord. Codec should not own this proof; I will test it through contextual decode.
